reason: R1-01 was triaged blocking but the round-1 commit 665f36b only removes blocking.md and edits state.json; `git diff 92ac2c3 HEAD -- internal` is empty. TC-004 'after the download was offered' still never checks when Collect returned, and assertInterruptedFailure only checks the generic failure result, not that the interruption caused it, so a run where clearCache ran with a live ctx before `at` passes silently (also on the pre-change code), against the tech spec risk note.

On the interrupted Page.navigate path (browser.go:429-432) the page was not opened either, so 'after a page not opened' is not false, and TS-AMZ-HCHK-018 only fixes the 'Amazon browser cache could not be cleared' prefix, which the line keeps. Wording a log suffix more precisely is a readability nit.
title: Neutral wording for the cache-clear failure log line
todo:
**Problem:** `clearCache` in `internal/amazon/browser.go` (around line 500) logs `Amazon browser cache could not be cleared after a page not opened: %v`. Since #233 it also runs when `Page.navigate` itself was interrupted (around line 429), where no answer to the navigation was received, so the suffix can mislead the reader of the log.

**Suggested work:** Drop the suffix (`Amazon browser cache could not be cleared: %v`) or let the caller pass the reason (navigation interrupted / page not opened). Keep the prefix required by TS-AMZ-HCHK-018 and check the tests matching `cacheLogLine` still pass.
